general.title: GATHER YOUR HERO COMPONENTS
general.body:
Use the full side of the Hero Board, as shown below:

Gather Your Hero Components

After choosing your Hero, take all components associated with that Hero:

  • Hero Board
  • Hero Card
  • Equipment cards
  • Dungeon Role Skill cards
  • Hero Skill cards
  • Class Ability cards
  • Starting Action Cubes

Each Hero has 2 Dungeon Role cards. These cards are part of the Hero’s basic setup and are used from the beginning of the Adventure.

When you choose your Hero, take the 2 Dungeon Role cards listed in that Hero’s section.

Your Hero Skill cards and Class Ability cards should be kept near your Hero Board, but they are not available yet. You will unlock them as your Hero progresses during the Adventure.

When you unlock a Hero Skill, you will also gain the Action Cube associated with that Skill.

Vorn.title: VORN – FRONTLINE DEFENDER
Vorn.body:
Vorn protects the Party by standing between his allies and danger. He can gain Shield, prevent damage, and keep enemies focused on him.

For this Adventure, Vorn uses the Defender Dungeon Role.

Core Components

Take Vorn's:

  • Hero Board
  • Hero Card
  • Starting Equipment cards
  • Starting Action Cubes

Dungeon Role Skills

Take the 2 Defender Dungeon Role cards.

Note: the Defender Role card has a Passive Ability that increases the Hero’s maximum health by 4. Adjust Vorn’s Health accordingly (16).

Progress Cards

Take all of Vorn’s Hero Skill cards and Class Ability cards and keep them near his Hero Board.

These cards are not available yet. You will unlock them as you progress during the Adventure.

general.title: GATHER YOUR HERO COMPONENTS
general.body:
Use the non-tutorial side of the Hero Board, as shown below:

Keep your Player Aid close at hand. We’ll refer to it occasionally, and you can use it to clarify any questions that come up regarding Keywords or the turn structure.

When choosing a Hero, take all associated components:

  • Hero Card
  • Hero Skills
  • Equipment Cards
  • Class Abilities
  • Dungeon Role Skills
  • Action Cubes (AC)

Vorn.title: VORN – PARTY TANK
Vorn.body:
Vorn is the frontline protector of the group. His premade build includes:

Dungeon Role: Defender

Take 2 Defender Dungeon Role cards, each with 2 abilities.

Hero Skills

  • Knee-Breaker (Melee)
  • Strong Block (Ranged)
  • Barrel Roll (Agility)

This gives him three Level 1 Hero Skill cards, plus 1 Action Cube for each Skill:

  • 1 Yellow AC for Melee skills
  • 1 Red AC for Ranged skills
  • 1 Green AC for Agility skills

Class Abilities

  • Battle Breath (Discipline)
  • Tackle (Tactics)

Fully Setup Player Board:

Lorelai.title: LORELAI – PARTY CONTROLLER
Lorelai.body:
Lorelai is the mage of the Party. Her premade build includes:

Dungeon Role: Controller

Take 2 Dungeon Role cards, each with 2 abilities.

Hero Skills

  • Displace (Agility)
  • Topple Down (Wisdom)
  • Epiphany (Wisdom)

This gives her one Level 1 and one Level 2 Hero Skill card, plus the corresponding ACs:

  • 1 Green AC for Agility skills
  • 2 Blue AC for Wisdom skills

Class Abilities

  • Spell Power (Arcane)
  • Researcher (Arcane)

Fully Setup Player Board:
